manual_terminal_resume: Open the Agent’s terminal and use Resume there. The decision is still open.
title: Task progress: {n}
answer_below: The choices are in the card below: one tap answers
accept_no_link: (no page to open directly; see the task)
accept_how_default: Open the link and see whether the change above is there
accept_reply_hint: Reply to this: “pass” marks it verified; anything else goes into the todo's decisions and back to its agent
accepted_by_supervisor: The supervisor checked the evidence: marked verified
accept_not_sent: Kept in the todo, but it could not go to the agent: {error}
accept_decided_not_sent: Your decision is recorded, but it could not go to the agent: {error}. Its supervisor will pass it on; it is not resent automatically
accept_not_taken: Not taken: the recommendation could not reach its agent ({error}). Nothing was changed; you can try again
accept_sent: Kept in the todo's decisions and sent to its agent
accept_media_dropped: Feedback on a check takes words only for now: the pictures and files did not go to the agent. Say in words what is wrong, or send the picture to it from the app
verdict_verify_pr: PR open, not deployed yet; check it below
verdict_verify_merged: merged, not deployed yet; check it below
verdict_verify_off: deployed, off by default; check it below
verdict_taken: Taken: the recommendation went to its agent
verdict_reply_hint: Reply to this: “OK” to close it; anything else goes into the todo's decisions and back to its agent
verdict_decide_hint: Reply to this: “OK” takes the recommendation; or write your choice. Either goes into the todo's decisions and to its agent
verdict_decide_hint_none: Reply to this with your choice: it goes into the todo's decisions and to its agent
verdict_over: sent back {rounds} times and still not done; how should it go on?
deadline_manual_resume: The deadline is {when}. The decision will stay open. To take the recommended option, resume the Agent in its terminal.
deadline_manual_resume_overdue: The deadline passed at {when}. The decision is still open. To take the recommended option, resume the Agent in its terminal.
deadline_default: No answer by {when} takes the recommendation (it can be undone)
deadline_irreversible: Deadline {when}; this cannot be undone, so it is not taken automatically, only reminded
deadline_overdue: Past the deadline ({when}); this cannot be undone, so nothing was taken: it waits for you
deadline_taken_reason: Taken by default: no answer by {when}
verdict_taken_default: No answer by the deadline: the recommendation was taken and sent to the agent
goal_now_cut: Stuck: cut off {n} times in a row
live_held_pr: not live: stopped at a PR
deploy_gate_out: Waiting for deploy: the running hub ({hub}) does not contain merge {merge} yet
deploy_gate_unmerged: The PR is not merged, so it is not deployed
deploy_gate_unknown: Deploy not confirmed: cannot tell whether the running hub has this merge
deploy_gate_not_in: Waiting for deploy: the running hub ({hub}) does not have this PR's merge yet
decision_from_assistant: Started by the assistant on {date}, in {where}
decision_from_leader: Started by a leader conversation on {date}, in {where}
decision_from_routine: Started by a routine on {date}, in {where}
decision_from_hub: Started by Persona itself on {date}, in {where}
decision_never_default: Never taken by default: it waits for you
outside_answered_default: No answer by the deadline: the recommendation was recorded for the requester
decision_chosen_to_agent:
The user chose this option:
{option}
(what it leads to: {leads_to})

Go on with it.
decision_response_not_what_i_asked: This isn't what I asked for
decision_response_noted: Answered “{response}”: passed to its supervisor, nothing was taken
decision_chosen_noted: Chosen: {option}. Kept in the todo's decisions and sent to its agent
decision_chosen_recorded: Chosen: {option}. Kept in the to-do's decisions
decision_chosen_for_supervisor: Chosen: {option}. Kept in the to-do for supervisor follow-up
verdict_taken_supervisor: Taken: it went to the task's supervisor, not its Agent
decision_chosen_supervisor: Chosen: {option}. Kept in the to-do's decisions and passed to its supervisor
delivery_verification_unavailable: Task {task} is not accepted: delivery status temporarily cannot be verified for {pr} ({reason}). This does not mean the work is unfinished. Keep its current state and check again when verification is available; do not request another merge or deployment, park, or cancel solely because verification is unavailable.
delivery_host_not_connected: Delivery of {pr} was not checked: Persona cannot read review requests on {host} yet, so your evidence stands.
delivery_host_unchecked: Delivery of {pr} could not be checked on {host} ({reason}), so your evidence stands.
decision_not_delivered: The owner decided: {decision}. It is recorded, but it did not reach the agent ({error}) and was not resent: pass it on once the agent can take it
